title: ISO 9013:2017 — Thermal cutting — Classification of thermal cuts and quality tolerances
locator: GPS and quality tolerances for oxyfuel, plasma and laser thermal cuts within specified material thickness ranges; applies when referenced by drawings or pertinent documents; Amendment 1 published in 2024.
notes: 只适用于标准范围内热切割边缘几何/质量；不自动覆盖折弯回弹、焊后变形、整体平面度或钣金件全部公差。
